line_items.reasoning: No specific Q1 capex figures were reported to compare against the full-year $225M–$245M guidance; operating cash flow was strong at $336M but capex tracking cannot be confirmed as ahead or behind from the available data.

FMI device signings hit 105/day in Q1 (first-ever 100+/day quarter), putting the full-year 26,000–28,000 MEU target well within reach, and Onsite logged 102 signings in Q1 alone, tracking solidly toward the 375–400 full-year target.

Management's warning of P&L headwinds proved accurate but worse than implied — total daily sales grew only 1.9% YoY vs. the ~4% expectation, operating margin contracted 60 bps YoY, and SG&A was pressured by substantially higher healthcare costs, confirming the 'subdued' environment was even more challenging than guided.
